proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits daily (refreshed every 24 hours). FLUX.schnell costs ~0.03 credits per image, meaning ~3000 free images per month.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides stable, fast, API-based access to FLUX.schnell, SDXL, and ControlNet models. Highly reliable and bypasses GitHub Actions IP blocks unlike AI Horde.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace Pollinations in the image generation pipeline (`produce_coloring_book` or `produce_kdp_cover`). A simple curl POST request with an API key from GitHub Secrets.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires API key rotation or strict daily budget management if multiple workflows run simultaneously.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month. No authentication required for basic usage, but a free API key increases rate limits.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any web page URL into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown. Perfect for scraping trend sites, Etsy search pages, or blog posts without writing complex parsers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into `agent_trendhunter` or `agent_opportunity_hunter` to scrape target websites directly within GitHub Actions and feed clean text to Gemini.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Websites with heavy Cloudflare protection might still block the Jina proxy.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to use the API. No monthly fees. Personal Access Tokens generated instantly.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatic creation of POD products, mockups, and automatic publishing to connected stores (Etsy, Pop-up store, etc.) without manual UI clicking.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Post-processing pipeline. Once an image is validated by `agent_gemini_quality_check`, a GitHub Actions script can automatically create a product draft (e.g., Mug, T-shirt) on Printify.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires initial manual setup of the store connection and shipping profiles.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to create products and use the API. Gumroad only takes a flat 10% fee on successful sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatic creation, file uploading, and metadata updates of digital products (coloring book PDFs, 3D assets, card games) via simple HTTP POST requests.
proposals.would_integrate_where: A new automated release pipeline. Once a digital asset (KDP PDF or Game Asset Pack) is compiled in GitHub Actions, it can be pushed directly to Hugo's Gumroad store as a live product.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High transaction fee (10%) compared to self-hosted Stripe, but completely free of fixed monthly costs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 10,000 free API calls per month across dozens of specialized APIs.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides clean, JSON-formatted data for trivia, quotes, dictionary definitions, historical events, and thesaurus searches.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used inside text-content generation scripts like `produce_quotes_minimal`, `produce_card_game`, or educational low-content KDP books to fetch raw, high-quality factual data.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Data is static and factual; cannot replace creative writing but serves as excellent scaffolding.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list assets. Creator revenue share is 88%, which is highly competitive.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The unified marketplace replacing Unreal Engine Marketplace, Sketchfab, and Quixel. Crucial distribution hub for 2D/3D gamedev assets, UI packs, and textures.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Distribution stage for `produce_gamedev_asset_pack`. Packaged ZIP files generated via GitHub Actions can be staged for manual/semi-automated upload to Fab.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: No public API for automated product uploads yet; requires manual listing upload, but the market reach is massive.
